manifest.name: react-router-v7
manifest.description: React Router v7 route-module best practices

behavior.promptTemplate: Use route modules as the primary boundary for UI, loaders, actions, metadata, and error boundaries. Utilize `loaders` for fetching deterministic data and `actions` for mutations/form submissions. Store shareable state in the URL search parameters and keep ephemeral UI state local. Avoid global state for data belonging to route loaders. Enforce type-checking on all `loader` and `action` return values.

provenance.notes: cursor .mdc rule (React Router v7); verbatim; example bundle for the repo schema
